meta.title: Marion County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Marion County's 2026 budget as adopted by the quorum court and filed with the state. Amounts come from the '2026 Department Final Budget Summary' pages. The County General Fund moves $3,009,097.25 to other county funds (the 'Transfers Out' column), so those dollars are counted again in the funds that receive them.
